content.short: Bungee is a powerful bridge aggregator that optimizes cross-chain asset transfers for speed, cost, and efficiency.
content.description: Bungee, powered by the Socket protocol, is a comprehensive bridge aggregator designed to simplify the multi-chain experience. It automatically scans dozens of bridges and decentralized exchanges to identify the fastest and cheapest routes for moving assets between networks. One of its standout features, "Refuel," allows users to acquire native gas tokens on a destination chain in a single transaction, solving the common "no gas" hurdle when entering a new ecosystem. Supporting over 20 networks, Bungee provides a seamless interface for single-click cross-chain swaps, where users can send one token and receive a completely different one on the target chain ecosystem.
